name: Labour Party
description: Governing party led by Prime Minister Andy Burnham since July 2026. Focuses on building a National Care Service, regional devolution, long-term public service reform, and public oversight of water and energy.

compass.rationale: Great British Energy, passenger rail nationalisation, 20% private school VAT balanced by fiscal discipline, strict border command, and antisocial behaviour enforcement.

name: Conservative and Unionist Party
description: The official opposition party, advocating for lower taxation, reduced state expenditure, a firm stance on cultural and constitutional institutions, regulatory rollback, and tighter borders.

compass.rationale: Lower taxation, opposing private school VAT, deregulation balanced by 3% GDP defence spending, mandatory National Service at 18, and border enforcement.

name: Reform UK
description: Right-wing populist party led by Nigel Farage. In February 2026, Farage unveiled Reform's first official 'Shadow Cabinet' team (including Shadow Chancellor Robert Jenrick and Shadow Education Secretary Suella Braverman) signaling preparation for government, advocating an immigration freeze, leaving the ECHR, and deregulation.

compass.rationale: Raising tax threshold to £20k, 15% corporation tax, private school relief combined with leaving the ECHR, net zero immigration freeze, and expanded police powers.

name: Liberal Democrats
description: Third largest party in Parliament, prioritizing NHS and social care reform, sewage prevention in UK waterways, proportional representation electoral reform, closer cooperation with the EU, and green transition.

compass.rationale: Market-driven economy with targeted windfall taxes and free school meals, combined with staunch civil liberties, electoral reform (PR), and rejoining Erasmus+.

name: Green Party of England and Wales
description: Progressive environmentalist party led by Zack Polanski (elected September 2025) with a 4-strong parliamentary group in Westminster led by Carla Denyer MP. Champions a 1-2% wealth tax on multi-millionaires, full public ownership of water and energy, rapid phase-out of fossil fuels, universal basic services, and major investment in council homes.

compass.rationale: Advocates aggressive wealth taxes, complete utility nationalisation, UBI, alongside drug reform, human rights protection, and strong civil liberties.

name: Scottish National Party
description: Scottish nationalist and social-democratic party advocating for Scottish independence within the EU, progressive taxation, an end to UK austerity, and universal benefits protection.

compass.rationale: Free university tuition, progressive tax bands, and public rail ownership combined with liberal immigration stances and European integration.

name: Plaid Cymru
description: Welsh nationalist, social-democratic party campaigning for Welsh independence, fair funding formulas (replacing the Barnett formula), green regional infrastructure, and protection of the Welsh language.

compass.rationale: Community wealth building, universal primary free school meals, public water ownership, and decentralized Senedd autonomy.

name: Restore Britain
motto: Restoring Heritage, Sovereignty and Free Enterprise
description: Emerging political pressure party advocating for restoring traditional British civil liberties, constitutional sovereignty, dismantling quangos, abolishing Net Zero statutes, and reviving regional manufacturing.

compass.rationale: Radical Whitehall downsizing, dismantling quangos, flat tax combined with constitutional restoration, traditional curriculum, and zero illegal migration tolerance.
